CHAPTER 5 — TRAFFIC COVERAGE AND IMPLEMENTATION CHECKPOINTS

Main progression: observe -> follow -> leave room -> pass -> return or abandon.
The reader moves from Practice to a small, repeatable Quick Race. Separate
driver modules avoid making the multiple-robots appendix a prerequisite.

Topic coverage
- Opponent collection from tSituation, self exclusion, inactive-car handling.
- Relative observations versus shared absolute state; lifetime/reset per race.
- Track-tangent projection of world velocity; body/world coordinate distinction.
- Metres/radians conversion and signed, lap-wrapped longitudinal distance.
- Center distance versus footprint gap; heading-based projected dimensions.
- Front/side/rear classification, closing speed, time and distance to catch.
- Following and front collision avoidance through a restricted target speed.
- Side collision avoidance with both occupied space and road boundaries.
- Passing-side selection; elapsed-time-based lateral target movement.
- Left normals on straight and curved target segments.
- Passing commitment, rear clearance before return, blocked-pass fallback.
- Waiting in traffic versus stuck recovery; nearby-car recovery inhibition.
- In-flight cancellation: actual-position holding reference, measured lateral
  drift, final constrained and rate-limited target checks, rear-hazard response.
- Current versus upcoming road width; narrowing speed bound through return,
  and low-speed completion once the body fits and the corridor is clear.
- Predictive-model limits; road departures and contact as well as lap time.

Verification matrix
- Solo baseline; equal-speed leader; slower leader; stopped/braking leader.
- Zero velocity and rotated footprint; ignored inactive car; self exclusion.
- Signed lap wrap, negative/rear gaps, cars on both sides, narrow road.
- Mirrored passes, completed pass, lost opening, consistent time-based slew.
- Recovery with clear space versus nearby traffic; session reset.
- Mirrored in-flight pass/return blockage through composed controls and native
  motion; late constraints invalidating a target; no checked alternative;
  narrowing alongside, checked release, and constant-width recovery rejoin.
- GUI-equivalent Quick Race, independent module builds, downloadable assets.

Chapter 6 and Appendices A–C provide the integrated driver and its extensions.
Private simulator fixtures and telemetry are not reader requirements.
